cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Can You Keep It?
cards.instruction: Use increasingly sensitive details to test whether someone deserves deeper trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The club's changing the menu. Keep that quiet before I tell you the bigger news.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won't tell anyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Not even the person you tell everything to?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You mean Sam?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We've found the first lock to check.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The club's changing the menu. Keep that quiet before I tell you the bigger news.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won't tell anyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not even the person you tell everything to?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You mean Sam?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We've found the first lock to check.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I withdrew my college application. Have you told Mum?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked. I said my sister's plans were hers to explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then there's more. I've leased a bakery. Can I send you the address?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Call me. Mum uses my tablet; she'd see the message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good catch. I'll call. It's Mum's old bakery. I want you there when I tell her.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem

cards.title: Hand Over the Proof
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then show me the one line you're using to decide for me.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Steer the Suspicion
cards.instruction: Hide your responsibility by redirecting every new clue toward a safer explanation before anyone can connect it back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. That ink on your new sofa must be from the delivery label.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The label's dry. You signed with your fountain pen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then the driver brushed my signature against the fabric. We should photograph it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your pen's still leaking onto the cushion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The delivery must have cracked it when they squeezed past me. Photograph the pen too; that's a second claim.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The gallery thinks your portrait would suit a more adventurous exhibition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're showing a fridge full of teeth. What did they say about mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. That the face doesn't immediately reveal what you intended.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's you. They called it unrecognisable, didn't they?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They think knowing the sitter would help. I'll attend your next opening with a matching shirt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nina's keeping her birthday dinner small. You and I can get noodles.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Small? She invited the whole choir.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She's choosing people she sees every week. It isn't a verdict on your friendship.

beats.text: She wants an uncomplicated evening. That's the kindest accurate sentence. Come have one with me.
